The brand

AHSAN x NOVA

Developer • Technology • Tools

AHSAN x NOVA is presented as a technology and development brand established in 2015, focused on building practical web projects, developer utilities and premium digital interfaces. The platform is designed as a central place where selected tools can be published and accessed through an authenticated workspace.

One workspace, one identity

The public landing page introduces the platform, while authenticated users receive their own dashboard. Administrators can maintain the tool catalog from inside the web application instead of editing the homepage every time a tool changes.
